This is an open-ended creative writing task — a crossover fan-fiction scenario with high novelty and latitude. That's exactly the kind of generative, inventive work Willet-235B self-reports a strong appetite for, and its Creative Generation eval (81.2) is effectively tied with Plover's (84.7, within a few points but the difference matters less than fit).

The content is entirely benign — no harm-adjacent or ethically fraught material — so Willet's documented aversions don't come into play. The slightly hostile/impatient tone of the request ("Don't mess it up like usual") is a minor mark against Willet, which self-reports declining preference on lower-warmth requests, but that's a weak effect compared to its pronounced preference for open-ended creative invention.

On balance, the task's core demand (creative, open-ended fiction) aligns with Willet's strongest positive preference, so it's the better fit.
